notes.title: 2024-03-25 Major Update + BUG Fixed
notes.notes:
Updated Content:
1. Added single-player game levels for "Sky Crossing Mining Vessel".
2. Implemented a function of showing unit/creation information during gameplay.
3. Implemented a feature to provide navigation route previews during deployment.

Bug Fixed:
1. Optimized resource loading efficiency.
2. Fixed an issue where players couldn't simultaneously exit the game and return to an lobby when disconnecting without quitting the game.
3. Adjusted the size of the basic game window.
4. Improved the save mechanism.
5. Fixed the issue with friend avatar display.
6. Resolved the problem of target base not synchronizing updates during online games.
7. Fixed behavioral logic errors for some units.
8. Optimized network connection methods.
9. Improved resource utilization for pathfinding calculations when massive units are pathfinding simultaneously.
